product.title: Stars Align Mini Dress
product.description: LIONESS Stars Align Mini Dress in Onyx is a partially lined mini dress in 95% polyester and 5% elastane, with a halter self-tie closure, hidden back zipper, lace trim, and midweight satin fabric. The shoulder-to-hem length is approximately 34 inches. Hand wash cold; made in China.
